scripts.lint: biome check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write . && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.check: pnpm check:pins && pnpm api:schema:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.prepare: lefthook install || echo skipping git hooks
scripts.api:schema: uv run python apps/api/scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --filter @app/api-client generate
scripts.api:schema:check: uv run python apps/api/scripts/export_openapi.py --check && pnpm --filter @app/api-client generate:check
